description: A student-defined offline source pack that satisfies the assignment constraints: no API, model, GPU, network access, or large dependencies.

sources.title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection
sources.summary: Establishes the single-stage YOLO detection paradigm by predicting boxes and class probabilities in one network.

sources.title: YOLOv9: Learning What You Want to Learn Using Programmable Gradient Information
sources.summary: Introduces Programmable Gradient Information and GELAN to address information loss in deep feature extraction.

sources.title: YOLOv10: Real-Time End-to-End Object Detection
sources.summary: Trains one-to-many and one-to-one heads with consistent dual assignments and removes NMS from inference.

sources.title: YOLOv7: Trainable Bag-of-Freebies Sets New State-of-the-Art for Real-Time Object Detectors
sources.summary: Systematizes train-time improvements and re-parameterization for real-time detection.

sources.title: YOLO-World: Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
sources.summary: Extends YOLO to open-vocabulary detection with RepVL-PAN and region-text contrastive learning.

sources.title: YOLOX: Exceeding YOLO Series in 2021
sources.summary: Switches YOLO to anchor-free detection with a decoupled head and SimOTA assignment.

sources.title: YOLOv6: A Single-Stage Object Detection Framework for Industrial Applications
sources.summary: Focuses on deployment-ready networks, quantization and hardware throughput.
